header: Tabs that show one panel at a time
lead: A row of tabs above one visible panel. Use it to shorten a long page or to switch between audiences.

panels.title: All panels in the markup
panels.text: Nothing loads later and nothing starts hidden. Search engines, printers and readers without JavaScript get every panel.

panels.title: Works with the keyboard
panels.text: Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump to the first and last, and Tab reaches only the selected one.

panels.title: Tabs scroll, they never wrap
panels.text: On a narrow screen six tabs scroll sideways. A second row of tabs would look like a separate group.
